node.title: WCL ell=1 weight-6 conductor and block-norm gcd fence
node.statement: Every all-one-parity signed weight-six support descends uniquely to its maximal lower two-adic conductor. At that minimal conductor the parity involution is free: an even-sector Heron block norm is the product of two complete signed rational norms, and an odd-sector descended quadratic block norm is the product of four. Hence every cross-pairing block-norm gcd containing one sign class remains divisible by that class's full rational norm and cannot compress its arithmetic obstruction. No compatible-prime exclusion is claimed.
